messages.content: 你能幫我計劃一次旅行嗎？我想先找出從紐約市我家到大都會藝術博物館的最短步行路線。然後，我想要估計走完這條路線需要多長時間。參觀完博物館後，我計劃騎自行車去中央公園。你能找到這次自行車旅行的最短路線嗎？最後，我想知道騎這條路線需要多長時間。

function.name: maps_shortest_path
function.description: Find the shortest path from one location to another by using a specific mode of transportation. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_location.description: The name or coordinates of the start location.

end_location.description: The name or coordinates of the end location.

mode.description: The mode of transportation (walk, bike, transit, drive).

function.name: maps_route_times
function.description: Estimates the time it will take to travel from one location to another by a specific mode of transportation. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

route.description: The string representation of the route.  Format is location 1 to location 2

mode.description: The mode of transportation (walk, bike, transit, drive).

message.reasoning:
The user wants to plan a trip. They want to find the shortest walking route from their home in New York City to the Metropolitan Museum of Art. Then estimate the time to walk that route. After visiting the museum, they plan to bike to Central Park. They want the shortest bike route and estimate the time.

We have two tools: maps_shortest_path and maps_route_times. We need to call maps_shortest_path twice: once for walking from home to Met, once for biking from Met to Central Park. Then we need to call maps_route_times twice: once for the walking route, once for the biking route.

We need to ask the user for the start location (home). The user said "from my home in New York City". We need the exact address or coordinates. We can ask for the address. Also we need the end location for the first route: "Metropolitan Museum of Art". For the second route, start location: "Metropolitan Museum of Art", end location: "Central Park".

We should ask for the user's home address. Then we can proceed.
